tools.name: networks.list
tools.description: Returns the social networks that can be connected to Blog2Social, including each network name, URL, network_id and whether profiles, pages or groups are supported. Use network_id and a supported network_type_id with connections.add to start connecting an account.

tools.name: connections.list
tools.description: Returns the social accounts currently connected to the authenticated Blog2Social user, with details such as the network, account type and display name. Use an account client_user_network_id in posts.create to choose where to publish.

tools.name: networks.properties
tools.description: Returns publishing capabilities and limits for each network and account type, such as supported media formats, video support and character limits. Check these requirements when preparing a post for a specific network and account type.

tools.name: connections.remove
tools.description: Removes a social account connection from the authenticated Blog2Social user. Call connections.list first to get the account's client_user_network_id. After removal, the account can no longer be used for publishing unless it is connected again.

tools.name: connections.add
tools.description: Starts authorization for a social network account. Get network_id and a supported account type from networks.list; network_type_id 0 means profile, 1 page and 2 group. tools.name: posts.create
tools.description: Publishes a post to the connected account identified by client_user_network_id. Use networks.properties to retrieve network-specific posting requirements before preparing the post. tools.name: posts.insights
tools.description: Returns the latest performance metrics for a post successfully published through posts.create. Provide the public publish_url returned by posts.create. tools.name: videos.status
tools.description: Checks the publishing status of a video post using the video_token returned by posts.create. Returns the status for each target social account: pending, failed or successful. A publish_url is included when publishing succeeds; check again while the status is pending.

tools.name: credits.balance
tools.description: Returns the current credit balance of the authenticated Blog2Social API account. Publishing is not possible when the balance is 0, so check it if a post cannot be published.

tools.name: account.overview
tools.description: Returns the current credit balance and daily credit usage grouped by endpoint and network. Optionally set days to a value from 1 to 30; when omitted, the endpoint default is used.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "connections.add" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: networks.list, connections.list, networks.properties, posts.create, videos.status, credits.balance · Public sink: connections.list, networks.properties, posts.create, posts.insights, videos.status, credits.balance · Destructive: connections.remove.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: networks.list, connections.list, networks.properties, posts.create, videos.status, credits.balance · Public sink: connections.list, networks.properties, posts.create, posts.insights, videos.status, credits.balance · Destructive: connections.remove

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "connections.add" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
